text:
Two separate circuits have different power supplies. Both power supplies provide the same
magnitude current.
Power supply P has an electromotive force (e.m.f.) of 1.5V and power supply Q has an e.m.f. of
3.0V.
Which statements about Q are correct when compared with P?
1
Q supplies twice the charge per unit time.
2
Q supplies twice the energy per unit charge.
3
Q supplies twice the energy per unit time.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 and 3 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Physics
